self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        return self.run_dir
evidence.reason: In `claim_run_dir`, the new run directory is created with `mkdir` and returned immediately. No fsync is performed on the record base (or its parent when the base is newly created), so the directory entry for the run directory can be lost on power loss even though later `durable_write` calls sync the receipt and the run directory itself. That can leave admission/host state persisted while the recovery evidence in the run directory disappears. The smallest compatible fix is to fsync the record base after creating the run directory, fsync the base's parent if the base was created, and fail admission if either sync fails.
